Faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
Faq.subtitle: Transparent answers to the most frequent queries from our Pune customers.
Faq.q1: Do you repair the phone at my doorstep or pick it up?
Faq.a1: Our technician arrives at your doorstep to inspect the phone and provide an official handover job receipt. The device is transported in a secure, tamper-evident pouch to our central Sadashiv Peth repair lab, where precision ESD-safe equipment and genuine OEM parts ensure flawless repairs before returning it to your doorstep the very same day.
Faq.q2: Do I need to share my lock screen password or format my phone?
Faq.a2: Never. We strictly follow a Zero Data Access Policy. You never need to share your PIN, password, or wipe your phone. You unlock the phone yourself to test touch, cameras, and display clarity once the technician delivers the repaired device back to you.
Faq.a3: Our warranty covers manufacturing defects, touch responsiveness, display flickering, and battery performance on the replaced parts. If any part fails within the warranty period, we replace it free of charge.
Faq.q4: How do you track my phone during transit and repair?
Faq.a4: Every pickup receives a unique booking reference code and physical/digital job sheet documenting device condition and IMEI. You can track progress and reach out directly via WhatsApp or phone anytime.
Faq.q5: Which payment methods are accepted upon completion?
Faq.a5: We accept all major UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit Cards, and Cash. You only pay after you personally inspect and test the repaired phone.
